name: Empower

every.note: spent to emit two elements of one cast in one action (peer.mjs planning)

text: Remove this permanent to immediately gain one bonus action spendable only for emitting an element (speed up casting).

ui.perm_help: Empower — your next cast puts two elements out in one action; spent then

effect.path: assets/Sprites/Effects/Effects1/Purple ring with + sign (buff marker)/Purple ring with + sign (buff marker) - idle [EZ67].png
effect.usage: effect animation strip (cols = frames; grid in assets/frames.json), play once at the target hex

spell.usage: WBC3 spell-cast sound paired with the EZ effect; play when the effect is cast

fx.usage: sound effect on resolution / impact of the effect

data.text: Remove this permanent to immediately gain one bonus action spendable only for emitting an element (speed up casting).

logic.description: Implemented (2026-10-29). While held, the next cast with elements left puts two elements out in one action (step +1) and the permanent is spent at that resolution. The one-element-per-action rule is broken only for that cast.

prerequisites.description: An instant rides on any action (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).

effects.description: Extra elements emitted in the action that spends Empower.
Rule 12: the permanent is placed with a point-buy die (re-rolled until the sum fits); that die is its power under Rule 24.
Rule 24: an enemy point-buy die of the matching stat destroys this permanent when it is at least the token value behind the cast element.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_concentration (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
